description:
Health probe for the Solana Market API data backend.

    Call this to gate or degrade gracefully BEFORE the other get_solana_market_*
    tools: it does a short-timeout hit on the data service and reports whether it
    is reachable, so an agent can tell "market has no data" from "service is down"
    without failing a real query.

    Free discovery tool. When the market data service exposes /status, the response
    includes prod_key_configured, data_first_available, and an actionable note
    describing what to configure for full on-chain visibility.
name: get_solana_market_status

available.description: True if the Solana Market data service responded.
available.title: Available

base_url_configured.description: Whether the market data-service base URL is explicitly configured.
base_url_configured.title: Base Url Configured

market_velocity.description: Full velocity payload when present (rank/trend/score/last_updated). Populated into ReadinessCard.root_provenance.market_velocity for WZRD protocol resources.
market_velocity.title: Market Velocity

velocity_rank.description: Velocity rank from market signals (higher better).
velocity_rank.title: Velocity Rank
